name: Tewodros I
contribution: Emperor of Ethiopia from 1413 to 1414, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty.

checks.lead: Tewodros I (Ge'ez: ቴዎድሮስ), throne name Walda Anbasa (Ge'ez: ወልደ ዐንበሳ; died 2 July 1414) was Emperor of Ethiopia from 1413 to 1414, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty. He was the son of Dawit I by Queen Seyon Mangasha.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
